about: The photo fixture's synthetic 0.1 m source (not swisstopo data): source.u8 holds uint8 R, G, B interleaved, row-major, rows north to south (row 0 at n_max), columns west to east (column 0 at e_min), no header; it covers lv95_box exactly and stands for the 1 km tile it lies in (tile), which datasets.lock.json pins with this file's SHA-256. Each texel of the 0.2 m grid is 2 x 2 source pixels; per channel their sum is 4L + d, d in -2..2, L the texel's designed value (tests/shared/photo_vectors.json).
format: uint8-rgb, row-major, rows north to south
